The lesions present in several different forms and can affect any skin site although the hands, feet, and anogenital areas are most frequently affected. Anogenital warts are known as condy- lomata acuminata. Treatment generally relies on some form of local tissue destruction (see p.1584). Interferons have also been used (see p.891).
